purpose: Improve the original seven-meter conifer gallery prop at 128–512px full-asset projection and 512px branch detail. Single showcase and sparse grove, not dense forest groundcover. Actual GPU and populated-scene measurements remain required before production acceptance.

criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.
Inspect every frozen diagnostic and turntable frame against references; silhouette, construction, proportions and materials must meet the brief.
Compare every diagnostic anatomical/botanical/geological feature with cited sources and label reconstruction uncertainty.
Verify the frozen brief, complete deliverables and all explicit constraints.
Parse this exact GLB with the pinned target loader and record bounds, materials and errors.
Render this exact GLB in the target graphics runtime; inspect frames and capture renderer/device and measured work.
Render the intended composed scene including this exact GLB; inspect scale/contact/material consistency and measure scene work.
Crown has dominant trunk, curved lateral boughs, subordinate branchlets and intentional negative spaces across the full turntable. No repeating cones or broad foliage leaves.
Branch bases taper into trunk with a rounded collar; no plank-like cross sections or detached foliage at detail and underside views.
Compound narrow sprays remain visibly conifer-like at 128/512px; their four alternate forward fingers read as grouped needle foliage, with no broad leaf laminae, starburst knots or long acute thorns.
Delivered labels preserve broad concept status, artistic scale/foliage grouping and modern-analogue limitations.

coverage_justification: 24 fixed-camera azimuth frames plus all orthogonal directions, alternate clay key, triangulated wireframe and visible middle-crown branch joins. Same scale, camera and lighting for original versus revised exact GLB.

claim_scope.taxon: No named extinct species or unchanged modern species claimed
claim_scope.representation: Aggregated needle-bearing branchlets, not individual measured leaves. Each central curved axis bears four shorter alternate narrow volumetric fingers with short tapered tips. Branchlet grouping and scale are artistic gallery-scale abstractions.

component_and_cause.primary: Continuous tapering main axis and open broadly pyramidal irregular crown.
component_and_cause.secondary: 26 curved primary boughs carry 134 staggered lateral branchlets and seven leader shoots. Alternating off-axis branchlets create a legible foliage envelope, with varying shallow elevation and preserved irregular sky windows.
component_and_cause.tertiary: Each branchlet has a slender central shoot plus four shorter, forward-bending narrow fingers. Their volumetric middle sections and short tip taper replace the thin thorn-like r7/r9 geometry. No broad foliage hull or individual-needle microgeometry is used.
component_and_cause.quiet_region: Exposed lower trunk and shaded interior bough bases.
component_and_cause.gaps: Unequal tier heights and one missing lower foliage fan leave understandable sky windows.

budget_rationale: The r9 same-count positional study remained too bare in actual 128px/512px images. r10 changes the middle-scale geometry: five-finger volumetric branchlets with shorter tapers spread laterally along boughs. It retains the 11k triangle / 850k raw byte study guards and three opaque materials/primitives; actual costs are recorded in metadata and technical evidence. No dense-forest or GPU performance claim is made.

runtime_profile.lod: No LOD claim in this study
